'''Zeta Squad ''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] under the command of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Its primary mission was to capture and move [[Wrenga Jixton]] to [[Darth Vader's Palace]], but failed due Jixton's quick ability to draw fire. The seven-man squadron fell due to the [[Death/Legends|killing]] spree of Jixton at the cantina.<ref name="Shadow Stalker" />
